'''Desnoy BHBM......first try''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Desnoy]]
* '''Published:''' 30 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed BHBM Desnoy DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is the BHBM deck of my frind, he want me to post it to have any comment on hit: how to improve, what wrong with it, well, everything good :

Ill put no strategie section because he dont really have one and he dont really think of one

rate this deck like you do everytime, I dont really care of my index, I dont post comment on deck because im not so good so I dont want to say bad thing. My friend thank in advance everyone for their comment

The published list has 57 cards.
